title: Interstellar
description: Astronauts travel through a wormhole near Saturn to find a new habitable planet for humanity as Earth becomes uninhabitable.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut is stranded alone on Mars and uses science, engineering, and determination to survive while NASA plans his rescue.

title: Ex Machina
description: A young programmer is invited to test an advanced artificial intelligence robot and begins questioning its intentions and consciousness.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A futuristic detective discovers a secret that could change the relationship between humans and artificial beings.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit begins a dangerous journey to destroy a powerful ring while being pursued by the forces of darkness.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: A young boy discovers that he is a wizard and begins studying magic at Hogwarts while facing a growing dark threat.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces a chaotic criminal mastermind who uses fear and violence to push Gotham City and its heroes toward their moral limits.

title: John Wick
description: A retired assassin returns to the criminal underworld and uses his deadly combat skills to seek revenge against those who wronged him.

title: Titanic
description: Two people from different social classes fall in love aboard a luxury ship during its tragic maiden voyage.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family tries to survive in a world where mysterious creatures hunt anything that makes a sound.
